config.label: Base URL of the aboard instance to read from
config.description: Base URL of the aboard instance to read from. Defaults to the canonical deploy; set it to point the server at another instance.

config.label: Service token issued by the aboard operator
config.description: Service token issued by the aboard operator. Needed only by the four write tools, each of which opens a pull request a human must review. The five read tools need no credential.
